intuition: Inorder traversal of a BST visits values in sorted order, so the minimum difference must occur between adjacent visited values.

brute_force.approach: Collect all values and compare every pair to find the smallest absolute difference.

optimal.approach: Traverse inorder iteratively and compare each value only with its predecessor.

edge_cases: At least two nodes are provided.
The smallest difference is between adjacent sorted values.
Do not compare a node with a missing predecessor.
